name: @aihq/catalog
description: Canonical Catalog content, pinned material and generic executable recipes; publication blocked during migration.

scripts.build:dist: node tools/check-not-candidate.mjs && node tools/clean-dist.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node tools/ensure-cli-executable.mjs
scripts.produce:ecc: npm run build:dist && node tools/produce-upstream-inputs.mjs ecc
scripts.produce:superpowers: npm run build:dist && node tools/produce-upstream-inputs.mjs superpowers
scripts.produce:mattpocock: npm run build:dist && node tools/produce-upstream-inputs.mjs mattpocock
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build:dist && npm run check:materials && npm test && npm run verify:workflow-action-pins

scripts.historical:check:catalog-index: node tools/check-not-candidate.mjs && node tools/generate-catalog-index.mjs --check && node tools/generate-catalog-collections.mjs --check && node tools/generate-catalog-qualification.mjs --check && node tools/generate-catalog-presentation.mjs --check && node tools/generate-catalog-categories.mjs --check && node tools/generate-catalog-runtime-descriptors.mjs --check && node dist/production/catalog-defaults-v1.js --check && node tools/check-committed-catalog-defaults.mjs
